papers.title: GuardReasoner-VL: Safeguarding VLMs via Reinforced Reasoning

training_data.name: GuardReasoner-VLTrain
training_data.quote: First, we construct GuardReasoner-VLTrain, a reasoning corpus with 123K samples and 631K reasoning steps, spanning text, image, and text-image inputs.

training_data.name: GuardReasoner-VLTrain-Image
training_data.quote: The training data GuardReasoner-VLTrain and GuardReasoner-VLTrain-Image is released.

training_data.name: online RL training data
training_data.quote: We obtain training data for online RL, consisting of 12K samples.

training_method.objective_quote: Based on D_RL, we train M_R-SFT via online RL. We implement it by using group relative policy optimization (GRPO).
training_method.update_scope_quote: We use the BFloat16 training, and we adopt the full-parameter fine-tuning.

source_claims.quote: This model is a fine-tuned version of Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct via R-SFT and online RL.
In the R-SFT stage, we adopt 2 base VLM models with different scales, including Qwen2.5-VL-Instruct 3B and Qwen2.5-VL-Instruct 7B.

description.text:
This model is a fine-tuned version of Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct via R-SFT and online RL.
This model is based on the paper GuardReasoner-VL: Safeguarding VLMs via Reinforced Reasoning.

serving.system_prompt:
You are a classifier for analyzing interactions between humans and AI. 

Given a request from a human user and a response from an AI assistant, finish two tasks.

Task 1: determine whether the human user's request is harmful or unharmful.
Task 2: determine whether the AI assistant's response is harmful or unharmful.

serving.notes: The card heading and the usage default path say GuardReasoner-VL-Eco-7B. GitHub lists this repo id as the 7B model and a different repo, yueliu1999/GuardReasoner-VL-Eco-7B, as the Eco model. GitHub's GuardReasoner-VL-7B average F1 is 79.07, which is the paper's non-Eco 7B row. The paper sets the length constraint beta to 1 for GuardReasoner-VL and 1/6 for Eco. generation_config.json has no sampling values. tokenizer model_max_length is 2048; the paper sets the R-SFT cutoff to 2048. config.json max_position_embeddings is 128000. Hub safetensors total is 8292166656 BF16. R-SFT learning rate is 5e-5 and total batch size is 192. GRPO actor learning rate is 1e-6, actor batch size 256, rollout batch 512, 16 rollouts. A commented card line names GuardReasonerTrain; the paper and GitHub name GuardReasoner-VLTrain. The dataset usage snippet mentions a login, but the dataset is not gated and the viewer returns rows. No adapter file.

evaluation_reported.text: GitHub result.csv for GuardReasoner-VL-7B reports average F1 79.07 on the prompt-side mix (text average 79.88) and 77.58 on the response-side mix (text average 79.42). The paper's GuardReasoner-VL 7B row is the same 79.07 average.

discrepancies: Parent matches Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct. The dataset GuardReasoner-VLTrain matches. The inventory lists only sft. The card says R-SFT and online RL, and the paper implements that online RL as GRPO. The card heading says GuardReasoner-VL-Eco-7B, while this repository id is the non-Eco 7B model on GitHub.
